integrity: All stated asymptotic claims follow from an explicit diagonal-coordinate tube decomposition and uniform corner bounds. Numerical checks corroborate normalization only; independent mathematical validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed sample size and fixed critical-window drifts; first-order small-variance rare-event asymptotics and conditional weak limits. Not a quantitative convergence rate or a universal statement for other parent densities.
title: Logarithmic critical-window localization for nearly constant Beta samples
